question: Where and when do buses bunch together, arriving close together followed by a long gap?
title: Bus bunching

requires.note: Waits for the gold transit measures to be installed (workstream B).
Needs at least one whole service day of recorded arrivals; the archive started at 21:05 on 21 Nov 2026.

answer.template: {trn.bunched_share_7d} of judged arrivals in the last 7 service days came bunched behind the bus ahead.

context.title: Bunched share by hour, last 7 days

trust.note: Bunched: less than 0.25 x the planned gap behind the bus ahead; long gap: more than 1.5 x (interim, not yet decided).
